up: Retrieve the first 1000 IC50 activity rows (standard type = 'IC50') for the human single-protein target CHEMBL1824 (Receptor tyrosine-protein kinase erbB-2). The result should include the following columns: assay_chembl_id (from assays.chembl_id), target_type (from target_dictionary.target_type), tax_id (from target_dictionary.tax_id), canonical_smiles (from compound_structures.canonical_smiles), molecule_chembl_id (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), standard_type (from activities.standard_type), and pChEMBL_value (from activities.pchembl_value). The rows must be ordered by molecule_chembl_id (ascending) and assay_chembl_id (ascending). No additional filters (e.g., on units, confidence score, or document type) should be applied beyond those explicitly stated. The target is defined as a single-protein human target (organism = 'Homo sapiens', target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN') with CHEMBL ID CHEMBL1824. The query should return exactly 1000 rows or fewer if fewer activities exist.
sql:
WITH target_info AS (
  SELECT tid, target_type, tax_id
  FROM target_dictionary
  WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1824'
),
activity_subset AS (
  SELECT
    a.activity_id,
    a.assay_id,
    a.molecule_chembl_id,
    a.standard_type,
    a.pchembl_value,
    a.standard_value,
    a.standard_units,
    a.type AS activity_type
  FROM activities a
  WHERE
    a.standard_type = 'IC50'
    AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
    AND a.activity_id IN (
      SELECT a2.activity_id
      FROM activities a2
      JOIN assays ass ON a2.assay_id = ass.assay_id
      JOIN target_info ti ON ass.tid = ti.tid
      WHERE
        ti.tax_id = 9606
        AND ti.pref_name = 'Receptor tyrosine-protein kinase erbB-2'
        AND a2.standard_type = 'IC50'
    )
)
SELECT
  ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id,
  ti.target_type,
  ti.tax_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  activity_subset.standard_type,
  activity_subset.pchembl_value
FROM activity_subset
JOIN assays ass ON activity_subset.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary ti ON activity_subset.assay_id = ass.assay_id
    AND ti.tid = ass.tid
    AND ti.tax_id = target_info.tax_id
    AND ti.target_type = target_info.target_type
    AND ti.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1824'
JOIN compound_structures cs ON activity_subset.molecule_chembl_id = cs.molecule_chembl_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON activity_subset.molecule_chembl_id = md.molregno
ORDER BY activity_subset.molecule_chembl_id ASC, ass.chembl_id ASC
LIMIT 1000;
